## Responsible person
The person responsible for personal data processed in connection with this website is:
**Simeon Lisovski**, Potsdam, Germany

This website is operated by Simeon Lisovski personally. The Alfred Wegener Institute is not responsible for operating this website or handling its contact enquiries.

## Visiting this website
This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub processes technical information needed to deliver and secure the website and confirms that visitors’ IP addresses are logged for security purposes. Our purpose in using hosting is to provide a reliable, publicly accessible project website, based on our legitimate interests under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
See [GitHub’s privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement) for its processing, retention and international-transfer arrangements.

## Contact enquiries
When you submit the contact form, we process your name, email address, optional organisation and message to respond to you and discuss your enquiry. Required fields are marked in the form; without them we cannot process a form submission. Please do not include sensitive personal information that is unnecessary for your enquiry.
The legal basis is our legitimate interest in responding to enquiries under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. Where an enquiry concerns steps towards a contract with you, Article 6(1)(b) GDPR applies. We do not use contact enquiries for newsletter subscriptions or marketing campaigns without a separate appropriate basis.

## Form submission and spam protection
We use Form.taxi, operated by wrkt*biz Reinhard Söllradl in Austria, to receive, filter, store and deliver contact submissions. Form.taxi also processes IP addresses, browser information and submission timestamps for delivery and abuse prevention. We use its spam filter and the form’s hidden spam-trap field; no additional CAPTCHA service is enabled.
Form.taxi states that submissions are processed within the EU. Its current documentation specifies an archive period of up to one year and deletion of spam after one month. These periods concern its archive; email copies are handled separately as described below.
Further information: [Form.taxi privacy documentation](https://docs.form.taxi/en/privacy).

## Receiving and responding by email
Form submissions are forwarded to a personal account used by the website operator to handle enquiries. Replies are sent through this account

## External links
Links to other websites take you to services operated by third parties. Their privacy information applies when you visit them.

## Updates
We will update this notice when the website or its processing arrangements change.
